description: Tool-call guard rules (parser-based), written in CEL; add your own in ~/.claude/bash-guardrails.json or .claude/bash-guardrails.json. On by default: blocks malformed bash and find rooted at /. Opt-in: Monitor, find without -xdev, pgrep/pkill pitfalls, until-grep loops, sudo, run0 confirmation, and pointing cat/head/sed/awk, heredoc writes, sed -i and Python rewrites to the Read, Write and Edit tools
name: bash-guardrails

cat_read.title: Use Read instead of cat
cat_read.description: Deny cat whose output is shown rather than used (cat f, cat < f), alone or piped into head, tail, sed -n 'X,Yp' or awk 'NR...' line pickers; point to the Read tool.

find_root.description: Deny find commands whose starting point is the filesystem root, even with -xdev.
find_root.title: Block find rooted at /

find_xdev.description: Deny find commands that do not stay on one filesystem (-xdev / -mount, BSD -x).
find_xdev.title: Require find -xdev

heredoc_write.title: Use Write instead of heredocs
heredoc_write.description: Deny writing a fixed heredoc or here-string to a file with cat (cat <<EOF > f) or tee; point to the Write tool.

line_range_read.title: Use Read instead of head/sed/awk
line_range_read.description: Deny head, sed -n 'X,Yp' (or 'X,Y!d', 'Nq') and awk 'NR>=X && NR<=Y' showing lines of a file; point to the Read tool with offset and limit.

malformed_bash.description: Deny Bash commands that fail to parse. Other Bash rules, including the run0 confirmation, rely on the parse, so disabling this weakens them.
malformed_bash.title: Block malformed bash

monitor_disabled.description: Deny the Monitor tool and point to background Bash.
monitor_disabled.title: Block Monitor tool

monitor_no_command.description: Deny Monitor calls that have neither a command string the shell rules can check nor a ws source.
monitor_no_command.title: Block Monitor without a command

pgrep_captured.description: Deny pgrep output captured in a pipe or substitution.
pgrep_captured.title: Block captured pgrep output

pgrep_f.description: Deny pgrep -f unless it is pgrep -af, and deny pkill -f.
pgrep_f.title: Require pgrep -a with -f; block pkill -f

python_edit.title: Use Edit instead of Python rewrites
python_edit.description: Deny python -c (or a Python heredoc) that imports re or calls .replace(), opens a file (open() or pathlib) and has a multiline string literal; point to the Edit tool.

run0_confirm.description: Ask the user, showing the wrapped command, before any run0 invocation.
run0_confirm.title: Confirm run0

sed_edit.title: Use Edit instead of sed -i
sed_edit.description: Deny sed -i on a single file when its script is only substitutions (and line deletions); point to the Edit tool.

sudo.description: Deny sudo and wrapped sudo; use run0 instead.
sudo.title: Block sudo

until_grep.description: Deny "until grep ..." and "while ! grep ..." loops that never exit if the writer dies.
until_grep.title: Block until-grep loops
